flags: phi step reinterpreted as 14.375 deg (345/24) to yield exactly 25 equally-spaced points spanning 0 to 345 deg inclusive, since a literal 15 deg step only produces 24 points in that range
chunked into 3 files (10+10+5 points) because the EXCLURAD Fortran reader accepts at most 10 kinematic points per input file
explanation: W=1.6 GeV is well above the eta+p threshold (1.4861 GeV) and cos(theta*)=0 is far from the +/-1 poles, so the kinematics are physically valid. The only correction applied was to the phi spacing: 'phi from 0 to 345 in 25 steps' is inconsistent with a literal 15 deg increment (which gives 24 points, not 25), so phi was distributed as 25 equally spaced values from 0 to 345 deg (step = 14.375 deg) to match the requested point count exactly. All 25 points passed preflight_check (PASS, 0 warnings, 0 failures) using default beam energy (6.53 GeV) and default vcut (0.166 GeV^2). Points were split across 3 input files per the 10-point-per-file Fortran reader limit.
